name: GetCellValue
label: Get Cell Value (HTTP)
description: Reads the value of a single Excel cell using Microsoft Graph HTTP GET.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The relative path to the Excel file in the OneDrive or SharePoint drive (e.g., 'Reports/Data.xlsx').

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet containing the cell to read (e.g., 'Sheet1').

fields.name: CellAddress
fields.label: Cell Address
fields.description: The address of the cell to read, in A1-style notation (e.g., 'B5', 'Z100').

fields.name: CellValue
fields.label: Cell Value
fields.description: The value retrieved from the specified cell. Returns text representation of the cell's content (including numbers, text, or formula results).
